title: Identification of CREB5 as a prognostic and immunotherapeutic biomarker in glioma through multi-omics pan-cancer analysis.
authors: Wu, Zhixuan; Wang, Xiaowu; Wu, Haodong; Du, Shengwei; Wang, Ziqiong; Xie, Shicheng; Zhang, Rongrong; Chen, Guorong; Chen, Hanbin
one_liner_zh: 该文通过多组学泛癌分析研究CREB5在胶质瘤中的预后和免疫治疗生物标志物作用，虽涉及转录因子CREB5，但未聚焦其与DNA的特异性结合机制，且方法以表达分析和机器学习预后建模为主，缺乏蛋白-DNA互作建模或物理模拟。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The functional relevance of cyclic adenosine monophosphate (cAMP)-response element-binding protein 5 (CREB5) in cancers remains elusive, despite its significance as a member of the CREB family. The current research aims to explore the role of CREB5 in multiple cancers. METHODS: Pan-cancer analysis was performed to explore the expression patterns, prognostic value, mutational landscape as well as single-cell omic, immunologic, and drug sensitivity profiles of CREB5. Furthermore, we incorporated five distinct machine learning algorithms and determined that the least absolute shrinkage and selection operator-COX (LASSO-COX) algorithm, which exhibited the highest C index, was the optimal selection. Subsequently, we constructed a prognostic model centered around CREB5-associated genes. To elucidate the biological function of CREB5 in glioma cells, several assays including cell counting kit-8 (CCK-8), wound healing, transwell, flow cytometric were performed. RESULTS: CREB5 was overexpressed in pan-cancer and was linked to unfavorable prognosis, particularly in glioma. Furthermore, genetic alterations were determined in various types of cancer, and modifications in the CREB5 gene were linked to the prognosis. The single-cell omics and enrichment analyses showed that CREB5 was predominantly expressed in malignant glioma cells and was critically involved in the regulation of various oncogenic processes. Elevated levels of CREB5 were strongly linked with the infiltration of cancer-associated fibroblasts and the Th1 subset of CD4(+) T cells. The validated CREB5-associated prognostic model reliably predicted the prognosis and drug response of glioma patients. The in vitro experiments showed that CREB5 promoted glioma cell proliferation, invasion, migration, and gap phase 2/mitotic (G2/M) phase arrest and recruited M2 macrophages into glioma cells. CONCLUSION: CREB5 has the potential to act as an oncogene and a biological marker in multiple cancers, particularly glioma.
abstract_zh: 背景：尽管环磷酸腺苷（cAMP）反应元件结合蛋白5（CREB5）作为CREB家族成员具有重要意义，但其在癌症中的功能相关性仍不明确。本研究旨在探讨CREB5在多种癌症中的作用。方法：进行泛癌分析，以探讨CREB5的表达模式、预后价值、突变景观以及单细胞组学、免疫学和药物敏感性特征。此外，我们整合了五种不同的机器学习算法，并确定最小绝对收缩和选择算子-考克斯（LASSO-COX）算法（其C指数最高）为最优选择。随后，我们构建了一个以CREB5相关基因为中心的预后模型。为阐明CREB5在胶质瘤细胞中的生物学功能，进行了包括细胞计数试剂盒-8（CCK-8）、伤口愈合、Transwell、流式细胞术在内的多项实验。结果：CREB5在泛癌中过表达，并与不良预后相关，尤其在胶质瘤中。此外，在多种癌症类型中检测到遗传改变，且CREB5基因的修饰与预后相关。单细胞组学和富集分析显示，CREB5主要在恶性胶质瘤细胞中表达，并关键参与多种致癌过程的调控。CREB5水平升高与癌症相关成纤维细胞浸润及CD4(+) T细胞Th1亚群密切相关。验证后的CREB5相关预后模型可靠预测了胶质瘤患者的预后和药物反应。体外实验表明，CREB5促进胶质瘤细胞增殖、侵袭、迁移和间隙期2/有丝分裂（G2/M）期阻滞，并招募M2巨噬细胞进入胶质瘤细胞。结论：CREB5有潜力作为多种癌症（尤其是胶质瘤）中的癌基因和生物标志物。
